name: science-monitor
description: Tracks finished manuscripts by submission: which journal, whether the cover letter exists and whether the package was actually sent, what decision came back, and every reviewer point still unanswered. `/science-monitor:context` pulls a manuscript's full working context into the session in one step; `/science-monitor:review` turns an incoming reviewer letter into tracked, answerable points; `/science-monitor:inbox` reads the connected mailbox for editorial decisions. Local SQLite store plus a self-contained HTML dashboard — nothing leaves the machine.
